name: Sumitomo Electric Wiring Systems
old_description: The rising demand for technologically superior electronic features in vehicles is the major driver of the automotive wiring harness and electronics markets. In today’s automotive industry, SEWS products set the standard of excellence while meeting and exceeding our customers’ expectations of quality, delivery, and cost.
about:
Sumitomo Electric Wiring Systems (SEWS) was established in 1987 as the North American arm of Japan’s Sumitomo Group, a conglomerate with a 400-year heritage. The company operates its North American headquarters from Farmington Hills, Michigan, and maintains additional locations across the continent under the leadership of President Kazuyoshi Nakai.

SEWS designs, develops, and manufactures wiring harnesses, electronic components, electric wire, and electrified-vehicle-related products for the automotive sector. Its portfolio spans complete harness assemblies, integrated electronics, and advanced product development services aimed at systems integration and modularization. The company emphasizes advanced manufacturing technology and global technical development across its North American footprint.

The company serves automotive original equipment manufacturers and tier suppliers, providing electrical distribution systems that address safety, comfort, fuel economy, and connectivity requirements. Its products are engineered for the evolving “automotive society” that connects vehicles, people, and infrastructure.

SEWS states its mission is to be the global leader delivering innovative electrical distribution systems that meet the demands of the ever-changing automotive market. The Sumitomo Spirit and core values—emphasizing efficiency, reliability, cost-effectiveness, and developing people to improve manufacturing—underpin its differentiation.
